Postgres.PORT: Private PostgreSQL listener; no public domain or TCP proxy.
Postgres.POSTGRES_DB: Dedicated Logto database name, fixed after first initialization.
Postgres.POSTGRES_USER: Dedicated database owner for upstream schema initialization and alterations.
Postgres.POSTGRES_PASSWORD: Generated database credential. Rotating this variable alone does not change the stored PostgreSQL role password.
Postgres.PGDATA: PostgreSQL-only persistent data directory within its own volume.

Logto.PORT: Private core listener, enforced by the wrapper as 3001.
Logto.ADMIN_PORT: Private administrator listener, enforced as 3002; not a public route.
Logto.NODE_ENV: Production mode; enforced by the wrapper.
Logto.DB_HOST: PostgreSQL private hostname; wrapper builds documented DB_URL with escaped credentials.
Logto.DB_NAME: Dedicated database name referenced from Postgres.
Logto.DB_PASSWORD: Database password referenced from Postgres; never an owner account password.
Logto.ENDPOINT: Canonical HTTPS issuer origin. Keep stable and consistent with application callbacks and Issuer gateway routing.
Logto.ADMIN_ENDPOINT: Independent canonical HTTPS administrator origin. All administrator paths pass through the Admin gate.
Logto.TRUST_PROXY_HEADER: Trust only the private gateways' overwritten forwarding headers; enforced by the wrapper.

Issuer.PORT: Public issuer gateway port, independently exposed by Railway.
Issuer.GATEWAY_ROLE: Must be issuer; selects private backend port 3001 and forces the core origin.
Issuer.UPSTREAM_HOST: Private Logto hostname; never an internet or user-controlled request target.
Issuer.ENDPOINT: References Logto's canonical issuer origin for fixed Host/protocol forwarding.
Issuer.ADMIN_ENDPOINT: References Logto's administrator origin so same-origin misconfiguration fails closed.

Admin.PORT: Public gated administrator gateway port, on its own Railway domain.
Admin.GATEWAY_ROLE: Must be admin; selects private backend port 3002 and forces the administrator origin.
Admin.UPSTREAM_HOST: Private Logto hostname; no public backend service domain.
Admin.ENDPOINT: References Logto's issuer origin for independent-origin validation.
Admin.ADMIN_ENDPOINT: References Logto's canonical administrator origin for fixed Host/protocol forwarding.
Admin.ADMIN_GATE_PASSWORD: Generated independent operator gate secret (48 characters). Username is operator. Required BEFORE first owner creation and permanently afterward; not a Logto password.
